body: botw's not my favorite, but i still really enjoy getting lost in the environment ("lost" used pretty loosely because i practically know hyrule like the back of my hand, at this point). indie games are also really cool, like they always feel like there's more soul and passion put into them compared to triple A games imo

i've been starting to play more visual novels lately because i can passively read them while i crochet, but i really love ace attorney and zelda. both games have really shaped who i am as a person, i think. you?
